about: Shaft drivers a person can drop onto the canvas with their nameplate filled in. Every row's nameplate validates against the part contract (tests/driver-catalog.test.js). `source` says where each number came from; a number marked typical is not a measurement — replace it from the datasheet of the unit bought. Rows used by another package name it in usedBy and a read-only cross-package test keeps the shared numbers (name, mass, price) equal.

drivers.name: Generic 12 V brushed DC motor
drivers.source: the lab's own default DC motor (the contract defaults): a mid-size hobby motor, typical values, not a measurement

drivers.name: 2306 brushless, 1700–1900 KV
drivers.source: name, mass and price from the embodied parts model (DRONE_FITS['recon-mini'].motor); noLoadRpm = 1800 KV x 14.8 V (4S nominal); Ke follows from KV (60 / (2 pi KV) = 5.3 mV s/rad); the 0.06 ohm winding (stall 247 A), 1 A no-load, 20 uH and 3 g cm2 are typical 2306 values, not measured. Solved as its DC equivalent behind an ESC.

drivers.name: 2807 brushless, 1300 KV
drivers.source: name, mass and price from the embodied parts model (DRONE_FITS['recon-3d'].motor); noLoadRpm = 1300 KV x 22.2 V (6S nominal); Ke follows from KV (7.3 mV s/rad); the 0.08 ohm winding (stall 278 A), 1.2 A no-load, 30 uH and 6 g cm2 are typical 2807 values, not measured. Solved as its DC equivalent behind an ESC.

drivers.name: 9 g micro servo (SG90 class)
drivers.source: the class's usual sheet: 4.8–6 V, 1.8 kg cm (180 mN m) stall, 0.1–0.12 s per 60 deg (500–600 deg/s), 1–2 ms pulses at 50 Hz; stall and running currents and the reflected inertia are typical, not measured

drivers.name: NEMA 17 stepper (17HS4401 class)
drivers.source: the class's usual sheet: 1.8 deg, 1.7 A, 1.5 ohm, 2.8 mH, 40 N cm holding, 2.2 N cm detent, 54 g cm2 rotor; the damping ratio is the lab's modelling default, not a datasheet figure
